x: Junior International Sarah Roberts boosted the points tally in the sprints and in the younger age group Marcella Simon had a great run in the 800 metres with Rebecca Lester picking up the 'B'event – both recorded best ever times.

Our women's Southern League team, managed by Jacqui Smiter and Cynthia James, have subject to confirmation achieved their aim of gaining promotion to Division 2; and Sarah Roberts (400m) became our first female T&F international for a good few years.
The 400 metres was particularly exciting and had a strong Belgrave interest as Sarah Roberts fought off Horsham's (and second-claim Belgrave's) Vicky Pincott.
It was touch and go throughout the afternoon with good points collected by Sabrina Scott in the sprints and Sarah Roberts in the 400 metres and triple jump.
